source_refs.note: Topic 2.6.2, printed page 33: the p orbitals (Figure 2.6).

blocks.text: The electron density of a 2p orbital is not distributed in a spherically symmetric way as in an s orbital. Instead a p orbital has two lobes on one of the axes. The three p orbitals are named px, py and pz according to their axes.

blocks.alt: Three panels on x, y and z axes, each a p orbital of two lobes meeting at the nucleus, one lobe shaded and one outlined, with a + sign: 2px along the x axis (l = 1, m = +1), 2py along the y axis (l = 1, m = -1) and 2pz along the z axis (l = 1, m = 0).
blocks.caption: Figure 2.6: The three 2p orbitals (original drawing after the textbook's Figure 2.6).
